name: smart-sprint-planner
title: Smart Sprint Planner
description: Multi-role sprint planning plugin for YouTrack 2024.3+. Supports 9 functional roles with separate composition tables, resources, and history snapshots. Plugin settings live in a dedicated widget with server-side authorization.
changeNotes:
What's new since v3.43.0

🗓 Work phases inside the sprint (3.45.0) — a “Work phases” block in Sprint parameters: six phases Analysis → Development → Tech test → Regression → Business test → Deploy with date pairs and a bar on the sprint scale, role chips from the phase × roles mapping in Settings → Release management, order and out-of-range warnings, range refusals; editors or validators save with their own button, phases are copied into every role snapshot and the Excel header; every date picker in Sprint parameters is now a Ring DatePicker. Also #127 — the estimate is written on Enter or leaving the field without a dialog, #128 — the task picker searches as you type. Schema 3.40.0 → 3.45.0, rollback floor 3.45.0.

🔗 Links to capacity and releases (3.44.0) — “Share” on the Capacity tab now puts the tab's sprint and the person or role picked on the right into the link, and the recipient lands on the same selection with it highlighted (all of a person's rows, or the role's group). Planned releases and release-history records got a “Copy link” button for everyone who can see releases; the toast names what was copied, and the highlight waits for the screen to finish loading. Also fixed: the address bar lost the Capacity and Releases sections on startup. Links need YouTrack 2026.1+, like “Share” itself.

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Planner settings for the project: functional roles and issue fields, permission groups (validation / editing / assignee assignment / history clearing), planning modes. Sprint planning itself lives in the main-menu item «Smart Sprint Planner».

widgets.name: Smart Sprint Planner
widgets.description: Sprint planning from YouTrack's main menu: pick an accessible project where the planner is set up, plan sprint composition by role, allocate tasks, review history. Permissions and settings are checked against the selected project. Includes a «Backlog» module for triaging and laying pool tasks into roles/sprint.
